comments.author: Maddog Matt
comments.body_html:
Yeah i would exercise caution with using this. Do not set it to some crazy high number for the lobby/stash FPS as that could potentially damage your GPU. Ie: Do not give yourself a 1000 FPS stash just because you can.

Many games in the past that had unlocked FPS cut scenes etc have killed GPUs that had hidden faults that were fine during normal gaming. D4 to name one recent example. As someone who builds and fixes PCs for many years i have seen it happen. It is rare but it sux big time when it happens to you.

But why would anyone set the fps higher than their monitors refresh rate?

comments.author: Mattdokn
comments.body_html:
Input lag goes down the higher your fps is, regardless of your monitor’s refresh rate. Above 90-120 though you likely don’t feel any difference if you’re locked to a 60hz monitor.

I first noticed input lag on 60hz when I was playing rocket league on my laptop as a kid. My monitor was 60 but getting anything under 75ish fps felt much worse in terms of how mushy the controls felt.

Also personal opinion, I would rather not use reflex and just have the game render more frames for me normally. Also unlocks the framerate for AMD users who dont have access to reflex.

comments.author: Klinical
comments.body_html:
This mod is amazing! although changing the max lobby framerate causes unpredicted issues with the game. Setting the slider to the right for me directly causes loading loot pools go from instantly, to twelve minutes. I have NO idea why this issue happens. There are other issues I have theorized to be this mods fault but I cannot blame it without proof. To test this I tried with and without the mod installed. I have not determined if this is the result of a mod conflict but I have determined this IS the mod causing the conflict. As well this could be a localized problem for just me. The mod simply being installed is not the issue though. Once you change the framerate is where the issue starts.

I love the mod though. I REALLY wish I could keep this since max fps lobby screen is something I can never go back from. The lobby is just so unclean at 60 fps, I feel physically dirty using such an inferior framerate.
